grid_rule: Cells with integer ix=floor(x/5000), iy=floor(y/5000); center=(ix+0.5,iy+0.5)*5000. Candidate centers inside intersection of source raster bounds; retain all-seven valid nearest samples. Each cell nominal area=25 km². This coarse, center-sampled study support is not exact coastline/land area.
point_cell_rule: floor projected coordinates / 5000; retain deposit lists; out-of-support points unlabelled-outside, never move them
label: P=at least one occurrence in retained cell; U=unlabelled elsewhere, not confirmed barren
block_rule: bx=floor(x/40000), by=floor(y/40000); sort unique (bx,by) lexicographically; fold=zero-based block rank % 5. No labels used to choose folds. Same deposit across cells must be reported as conflict. A fold without P has undefined AP/AUC/capture, report it rather than alter the split.
scaler: Training rows only, population standard deviation ddof=0; std=0 -> z=0
knowledge_score: dot(z, weights), scaler train fold !=0; no probability interpretation
PU_centroid_baseline: For each held-out fold, fit scaler on other folds; obtain mean z vectors mP,mU on training only; score=dot(z,mP-mU)-0.5*(dot(mP,mP)-dot(mU,mU)); no probability claim. If either class absent, fold undefined.
area_selection: sort score descending then cell_id ascending; longest prefix cumulative area <= budget*total area; actual selected area fraction used in lift
AUROC: pairwise P vs U wins + 0.5 ties, divided by nP*nU
AP: group identical score thresholds; sum over thresholds (recall_i-recall_previous)*precision_i; no linear interpolation
reporting: show per-fold denominators, undefined values, macro and pooled summaries separately; no universal skill threshold; all OOF predictions held_out=1; grouped splits reduce but do not certify absence of spatial/deposit leakage
